# Steamworks SDK (external, licensed)

Valve distributes the Steamworks SDK to authorized Steamworks partners. Do not vendor the proprietary SDK source or binaries into this public repository.

Acquire the SDK through the Steamworks partner portal, install it outside the repository, and configure an engine-owned SDK root when the Steamworks integration target is implemented. There is currently no `SIR_WITH_STEAMWORKS` CMake target or validated linking path.

This directory is an acquisition record, **not** an SDK source import.
